$comment: RAW CAPTURE — exactly what Figma MCP returned, per node, nothing added.
This file is the evidence behind tokens.snapshot.json. It is committed so a
reader can check the snapshot against the thing it was derived from, and so a
later capture can be diffed against this one rather than against a summary.
Produced by an agent (or a human) running get_variable_defs over the node
list below and pasting each response verbatim. It is NOT machine-generated:
Figma MCP is an agent tool, not something a Node script can call. See
COVERAGE IS BINDING-DRIVEN. get_variable_defs returns only variables actually
bound somewhere in the queried subtree, so a variable that exists in the file
but is used by nothing cannot appear here at any node. That is a limit of the
method, not a claim that such variables do not exist.
